response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT s.zoneref, t.riskeval, s.pressratio FROM scans AS s INNER JOIN sites AS t ON t.zoneregistry = s.zoneref) SELECT zoneref AS site_code, riskeval AS risk_evaluation_status, AVG(pressratio) AS average_compression_ratio, COUNT(*) AS scan_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM matched) AS share_of_matched_scans FROM matched GROUP BY zoneref, riskeval ORDER BY share_of_matched_scans DESC LIMIT 10;

assumptions.assumption: At least 10 groups exist; otherwise the query returns all available groups.
